installation.note: info is commonly available by default; some packages add info pages

overview.summary: info displays GNU Info documentation, a hypertext help system. Many GNU tools have both man and info pages; info often has more detailed or structured documentation. Use arrow keys and Enter to navigate.
when_to_use: Read detailed documentation for GNU tools
Alternative to man when info pages exist

syntax.description: TOPIC can be a command name or info node. Without TOPIC, info shows the directory of available docs.

options.description: Search for STRING in all info indices

related_commands.description: Manual pages; many commands have both man and info
